change.description: Future analytics module ownership cutover detailed in docs/design/analytics-module-postgres-ownership.md under ADR 0054.
change.release_unit_description: Candidate runtime implementation remains unassigned; the present work adds design documents only.

planned.reasoning: Introduce an optional module-level PG backend and a new durable ownership/publication contract while preserving public API shapes and default SQLite operation. Earlier-Minor binaries need not interpret the newly migrated analytics control state.

scope_drift.description: No runtime implementation; proposed scope and compatibility remain subject to owner review.

current.reasoning: The proposed runtime unit has separate API compatibility and persistent-state compatibility gates; backend rollback uses an epoch-aware binary.

verified.reasoning: No runtime compatibility tests or release-unit verification have been executed.

public_api.supported_consumer_range: Existing HTTP/SSE consumers; response shapes, timezones, null/sample semantics and runtime-tail behavior must remain compatible. Any unavailable/status change requires explicit compatibility review.

persistent_state.state_description: Versioned source control and envelopes, PG owner/build/publication state, certified historical seeds and rollback coverage.
persistent_state.source_program_compatibility_range: Baseline fixtures v4.19.5 and v4.19.6 plus an explicitly enumerated supported earlier-Minor list before acceptance; arbitrary old-binary rollback is not promised.
